name: Jimi Hendrix
blurb: Guitar virtuoso whose feedback-drenched, heavily amplified psychedelic blues set the template for what loud guitar could do.

name: Black Sabbath
blurb: Tony Iommi's down-tuned, doom-laden riffs and Geezer Butler's occult lyrics defined the blueprint of heavy metal.

name: Led Zeppelin
blurb: Blues-rock turned monolithic; the heavy riffing and mythic imagery of Zeppelin shaped a generation of metal bands.

name: Ramones
blurb: Three-chord, two-minute songs at breakneck speed: the punk template that thrash later fused with metal.

name: Misfits
blurb: Horror-punk pioneers whose melodic, fast, dark songs were a huge influence on Metallica and others.

name: AC/DC
blurb: Riff-first, no-frills hard rock that became one of the biggest-selling acts of all time.

name: Van Halen
blurb: Eddie Van Halen's tapping and virtuosity rewired what electric guitar could do in a hard rock band.

name: Judas Priest
blurb: Twin-guitar harmonies, leather and studs and Rob Halford's operatic voice: the archetype of heavy metal.

name: Motörhead
blurb: Lemmy's "if we moved in next door your lawn would die" band: punk speed with metal weight, loved by both crowds.

name: Iron Maiden
blurb: Steve Harris's galloping basslines and twin-guitar epics made Maiden the flagbearer of the NWOBHM.

name: Saxon
blurb: Denim-and-leather NWOBHM stalwarts with a blue-collar, anthemic approach.

name: Venom
blurb: Raw, abrasive and shameless; their sound and name lent black metal its label and thrash its attitude.

name: Exodus
blurb: Bay Area thrash originals whose Bonded by Blood is a scene cornerstone.

name: Metallica
blurb: From a classified ad in LA to the biggest metal band in the world; the thrash movement's main commercial force.

name: Slayer
blurb: Relentlessly fast, dark and precise; Reign in Blood is thrash at its most extreme.

name: Anthrax
blurb: New York's thrash standard-bearers, mixing hardcore energy with humour and big riffs.

name: Megadeth
blurb: Dave Mustaine's technical, venomous answer to his dismissal from Metallica.

name: Sepultura
blurb: Brazil's metal ambassadors, from raw death/thrash to groove-laden tribal metal.

name: Possessed
blurb: Their demo and Seven Churches are often cited as the first true death metal.

name: Death
blurb: Chuck Schuldiner's band moved from gore-soaked thrash to technical, progressive death metal.

name: Ozzy Osbourne
blurb: Black Sabbath's original vocalist, solo star and the "Prince of Darkness". Included here for events only.

name: Bathory
blurb: Quorthon's one-man project that defined the rawest first wave of black metal.

name: Napalm Death
blurb: Grindcore pioneers: blast beats, hardcore politics and sub-minute songs.
